Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
Urinalysis shows significant bacteriuria (>100,000 CFU/mL E. coli), leukocyturia, nitrites, hematuria, and elevated urine glucose, consistent with a urinary tract infection (UTI). The presence of blood and leukocytes suggests inflammation, while low specific gravity may indicate dilute urine. Recommend clinical correlation and consideration of antibiotic therapy.
